# acia terminal

Check the selected ACIA revision and TX-status erratum. Verify register side effects, serial framing and deadline timing, overrun, IRQ and relevant modem signals. Feed paced input through the serial endpoint. Compare output to the pinned WozMon fixture.

Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) for the workflow.
